units.motor_velocity: rad/s or m/s; bind by motor type

initial_state.source: must be bound from verified model; never teleported to fake motion

collision_coverage.terrain: generated visible primitive reused as boundingObject

cancel_conditions: worker disconnected or outcome unknown: stop dispatch, never blindly replay
nonfinite observation or source/model hash drift
measured host resource limit exceeded once calibrated

judgement.owner: A04 physical validity; A01/A02 model calibration
judgement.policy: Process exit, empty contacts, generated geometry and completed steps alone never imply physical PASS.

static_preflight.goal: Before launch, inspect file references, source units/frame, declared model complexity and conversion limitations.
applies_to: URDF plus local meshes and source manifest; no Webots needed
actions: read-only static inspection; current production validator integration pending

conversion_calibration.goal: Compare asymmetric dimensions and instance/pose/mass provenance before larger experiments.
applies_to: A01/A02 calibrated asymmetric rigid-body model; synthetic fixture alone does not qualify
actions: inspect world/model identity and measured fields; no invented transform
observations: source dimension versus observed field units

drop_or_rest.goal: Capture bounded free fall or rest of a verified rigid body above a known ground plane.
applies_to: single verified dynamic body with known boundingObject and physical attributes
actions: no motor drive; advance bounded simulation from explicitly bound pose

joint_contact_probe.goal: Sample an explicitly bound single motor/sensor and related contact region within verified limits.
applies_to: verified single revolute/prismatic joint and real motor/sensor device pair
actions: bind motor device/type/velocity/target/effort from verified model; no default motion
read paired position sensor each batch; restore/stop policy must be bound before dispatch
observations: expected and unexpected candidate contact pairs

terrain_traverse.goal: Collect traversal evidence on parameterized ground, stairs, slope or box obstacle.
applies_to: mobile robot with calibrated collision/drive; terrain dimensions must suit robot class
actions: bind actual drive devices, direction, velocity and stop policy; no pose edits
advance bounded batches and record actual sensors/contacts

paired_step_comparison.goal: Prepare a two-trial comparison with identical model/scene/initial state/action hashes at 32ms then 16ms; evaluation belongs to A04.
applies_to: previously calibrated small scene and resource budget; one sequential instance
actions: prepare separate sequential worlds at time_step_ms=32 and 16; plan uses 64 and 128 steps respectively for equal 2.048s duration; no automatic run or reset
preserve seed/source/initial-state/actions and compare actual observations, not only exit codes
